open_points.subject: K-02 function purity vs A03 sandbox filesystem
open_points.text: K-02: "no network, no filesystem beyond its input"; A03 rule 1: "one private exchange directory bounded by `sandbox_scratch_bytes_max` ... opening any path outside the exchange directory and the read-only runtime"
open_points.question: Are function implementations allowed to read/write files in the sandbox exchange directory, or must all filesystem access be refused to keep functions purely input/output only?
options: Allow read/write inside the private exchange directory only.
Refuse all filesystem access from function code (except runtime internals), including exchange-directory file I/O.
open_points.default_guess: Allow read/write in the private exchange directory as temporary scratch, because A03 explicitly permits that path.

open_points.subject: A05 map_over source semantics
open_points.text: A05 rule 1 phase 5: "a `many` output feeds a `many` input, or a `one` input that is its node's `map_over` port... A node with `map_over` has exactly one input fed that way"
open_points.question: Must a `map_over` port be fed by an incoming edge from a `many` output, or may it be supplied by a flow constant/list (or another non-edge source)?
options: Require exactly one incoming edge from a `many` source to the `map_over` port.
Allow `map_over` to use either a `many` edge or a constant/list source, with exactly one total source.
open_points.default_guess: Require one incoming `many` edge for `map_over` and refuse constant-fed mapping.

open_points.subject: A08 binding acceptance when digest drift and other mismatches coexist
open_points.text: A08 rule 7: "a `proposed` one is checked again by every check of rule 5 ... refused naming that check ... with `binding_stale` when only the digest differs"
open_points.question: If the manifest digest changed and another rule-5 mismatch is also present, which refusal reason must be returned, and at what point is digest comparison evaluated?
options: Run all rule-5 checks first; if any fail, return the first such mismatch; only if they pass, compare digest and return `binding_stale` on difference.
Give digest drift (`binding_stale`) precedence over all other mismatches whenever digest differs.
Treat any digest difference as part of rule-5 ordering and place it at a defined position in that order.
open_points.default_guess: Apply rule-5 checks first and return their first failure; return `binding_stale` only when rule-5 checks pass and only digest differs.
